title: Establish Acarat governance, engineering, identity, property, and Saudi geo foundation
outcome: Acarat has a rights-qualified engineering foundation, Saudi-first identity/regulatory boundaries, durable property/listing semantics, and reliable geospatial truth before marketplace expansion.
rationale: Program-level child covering roadmap P00-P04. It must be recursively refined before implementation.
scope_in: P02 identity, tenancy, privacy, and regulatory trust
P03 property, land, unit, and listing truth
P04 Saudi geo/address and map foundation
acceptance: Every P00-P04 roadmap phase is decomposed into bounded executable Grains with explicit source, security, privacy, Arabic/RTL, accessibility, test, rollback, and evidence requirements.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; implementation rollback is defined by refined Grains.
